build_geometry_from_IMAS_filepath: build geometry from an IMAS equilibrium file using IMASConfig with imas_filepath parameter
build_geometry_from_IMAS_URI: build geometry from an IMAS equilibrium using an imas:hdf5 URI instead of a local file path
build_geometry_from_equilibrium_object: build geometry by passing a pre-loaded equilibrium object to IMASConfig
load_specific_time_slice: load a specific time slice from a multi-slice IMAS IDS file using slice_time or slice_index
build_geometry_provider_all_slices: build a geometry provider that loads all time slices from a multi-slice IMAS IDS file
